title: Role of interlayer spacing and functional group on the hydrogen storage properties of graphene oxide and reduced graphene oxide
material_description: GO | graphene oxide synthesized by modified Hummers' method from graphite powder (<45 um) with NaNO3, H2SO4, KMnO4 and 30% H2O2; separated by centrifugation at 7000 rpm (brown pasty material)
functional_groups: O-H (3130 and 1406 cm-1), C-O epoxy/alkoxy (1124 cm-1), C=O carboxylic acid (1640 cm-1) by FTIR
source_location: main, p.14 (main-15), Hydrogen Storage Performance text after Fig. 8 ('The increase H2 uptake (1.90wt%)capacity of GO'); pressure from p.13 (main-14) 'in the graphene oxide at same pressure' (80 bar); also abstract p.1 (main-02), Introduction p.4 (main-05) and Conclusion p.14 (main-15)
notes: GO value 1.90 wt% printed in abstract, Introduction, Results and Conclusion ('about to 1.90 wt. %'); one measurement. Pressure 80 bar from p.13 'significant increase in H2 uptake was observed in the graphene oxide at same pressure' (same as rGO at 80 bar) and abstract 'pressure up to 80 bars'. Interlayer spacing printed 8.84 A (XRD (002) peak 2theta = 9.96 deg, Fig. 5). Temperature stated only as 'room temperature' (no number). Pressure as printed '80 bar'; gauge or absolute not stated, stored as printed. Basis not named (paper says 'uptake', 'absorption', 'hydrogen storage capacity'); volumetric instrumental default excess. Fig. 8 (hydrogen absorption wt% vs time in seconds; a kinetics plot although the text calls it an isotherm) not digitized; no plotted uptake-vs-pressure isotherm, so no isotherm_id. No surface area or pore volume reported for any sample. Degassing: 'degassed under rotary vacuum (10-2 tor) at room temperature'; end pressure printed 10^-2 tor = 1.33322 Pa; degas temperature in words only; duration not stated. Instrument: 'indigenous fabricated volumetric apparatus' (home-built Sieverts, stainless steel and brass, B-series ball valves, A-lock fittings, 100 bar pressure transducer, computer interface; schematic Fig. 1; design similar to ref. [28]). Calibration: 'The volumes of sample cells for high-pressure system were precisely measured for calibrations' (method/gas not stated), so calibration_described false. Replicates: 'Hydrogen adsorption was determined by exposing the samples to hydrogen gas at pressure 80 bar for six times' with no separate results or uncertainty, so replicates_reported false.
